text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our debut race is coming up. Once that's
behind
us, we need to decide on
Jordan's race schedule,
so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Beats me. I'll leave that to you.
choice_data_list: Is there a race you want to run?
Is there a race you'd like to run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's starting to get overwhelmed, but
having a
concrete goal will help with her
daily motivation
and growth.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh.
choice_data_list: (Ideally, I want her to be aware of it herself, too.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I might have one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Welllll...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna make it big!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gives me a goal as vague and
formless as a
passing cloud in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, the day of her debut race has
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is waiting restlessly in the
prep
room, fidgeting with her nails in
between sips of
water.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-not at all! I'm totally gravy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I came to cheer you on! Are you
loose and
limber?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got a message from City and the
others too.
They said to tell you, "This is
the real deal, so
bring back a victory!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The real deal...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But what if I...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: U-uh, never mind. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be easier to discuss a problem
with just
your friends sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: I'm stepping outside for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Take your time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So? What's up, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Palmer... I'm scared. This is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, the real deal. I always thought I'd be way more badass when the time came!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I even told my trainer I was gonna make
it big!
But I... I...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What if it's like back before I met my
trainer, and
I can't run right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but your eyes just now told me that
running
away isn't an option.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you're honestly terrified, but
your need to
test yourself is even
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you want to see if this stronger
you can
finally perform in the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason we train every day is
so we can
run in races, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So take all that practice you've done up
until now
and use those legs of yours to
win this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides! Even if you mess up, you just
run in a
maiden race next! Actually,
that's what I did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's surprisingly okay! It gets you pretty
pumped in
its own way. No lie, it might
be worth trying at
least once.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What?! The whole reason I want to win is
to avoid
that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sorry. You mad? My bad, fam.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But you should hold onto that feeling
until you
cross the finish line. You'll be
fine—you got this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer and I will both be watching
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even if you do mess up this one time, I'll always be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're my girl, after all. And your
trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, you said yourself your trainer is
probably
good for you. That means you
work well together,
right? At least a
little.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I'm heading to the
paddock.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan steps out into her debut
race.
